query:
insert or ignore into TraceMappedLinesCoveredByFailedTestRuns (
                agg_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                test_collect_nr,
                test_run_name,
                test_run_date,
                file_collect_nr,
                filepath,
                file_hash,
                traced_line,
                cov_line
            )
            select
                tc.agg_collect_nr,
                tc.product_id,
                tc.test_collect_nr,
                tc.test_run_name,
                tc.test_run_date,
                tc.file_collect_nr,
                tc.filepath,
                tc.file_hash,
                tc.traced_line,
                tc.cov_line
            from TraceCoveragePerTestRuns tc, FailedTestRuns ftr
            where tc.agg_collect_nr = $1 and ftr.agg_collect_nr = $1
            and tc.product_id = ftr.product_id
            and tc.test_collect_nr = ftr.test_collect_nr
            and tc.test_run_name = ftr.test_run_name
            and tc.test_run_date = ftr.test_run_date
            and tc.hits > 0
